stem: A manufacturer wants to migrate from an on-premises Oracle source to an on-premises PostgreSQL target and asks whether AWS DMS can do this directly.

choices.text: Yes; AWS DMS supports direct on-premises to on-premises endpoint pairs when schemas are converted first.
No; AWS DMS requires at least one endpoint, source or target, on an AWS service.
Yes; AWS DMS allows both endpoints on premises when replication traffic uses VPN links.
No; AWS DMS supports only homogeneous engine migrations.

rationale: AWS DMS requires at least one endpoint on an AWS service, so direct on-premises-to-on-premises endpoint pairing is not supported. Schema conversion and VPN transport do not remove the endpoint-location constraint. DMS supports both homogeneous and heterogeneous migrations when endpoint requirements are met.
